description: A fast, deterministic Rust implementation of DiMA, the sequence diversity dynamics analyser for viruses (Tharanga et al. 2025, Briefings in Bioinformatics 26(1):bbae607). It quantifies the diversity of viral protein or nucleotide alignments by k-mer position: Shannon entropy with a sample-size correction, optional similarity-weighted entropy (Wu 2025, Virus Evolution 11(1):veaf029), Index/Major/Minor/Unique motif classification, metadata stratification and historically conserved sequences. Command-line tool and desktop application.
title: dima: sequence diversity dynamics analyser for viruses (Rust implementation)
